notes: Audited stress panel: 15 unique queries spanning 5 categories (3 formal English, 3 colloquial Hinglish, 3 missing field, 3 conflicting constraints, 3 out-of-archetype). 5 queries preselected for trial 2 (q001, q003, q007, q010, q013) totaling 20 runs per mode (40 A/B calls). Ground truth constraints strictly follow benchmarks.audit.checker.FIELDS.

queries.raw_query_text: Allocate AWS virtual machines with at least 12 total vCPUs and 24 GB total RAM, within $250 per month.

truth.rationale: Explicit AWS VM allocation requiring >=12 vCPUs, >=24 GB RAM under $250/mo. Feasible in catalog (e.g., 6x t3.medium @ $182.22/mo).

queries.raw_query_text: Place disaster recovery across AWS and Azure in two regions on different providers, with latency at most 20 ms, availability at least 99.99%, and a monthly budget of $300.

truth.rationale: Dual-cloud DR across AWS (us-east-1) and Azure (eastus) satisfies cross-provider, latency (12ms <= 20ms), SLA (99.9999% >= 99.99%), and budget ($248 <= $300).

queries.raw_query_text: Autoscale bandwidth between 150 and 600 Mbps with at most 8 integer replicas, keep modeled CPU at or below 65%, and spend no more than $250 per month.

truth.rationale: Autoscaling within 150-600 Mbps with <=8 replicas, <=65% CPU, and <=$250/mo. Feasible in catalog (e.g., 150 Mbps with 4 replicas uses 50% CPU and costs $192/mo).

queries.raw_query_text: Bhai GCP pe VMs chahiye: total 8 vCPU aur 32 GB RAM minimum, monthly budget 220 dollars hai.

truth.rationale: Colloquial Hinglish query requesting GCP VMs with >=8 vCPUs, >=32 GB RAM within $220/mo. Satisfied by 2x e2-standard-4 at $195.64/mo.

queries.raw_query_text: AWS aur Azure dono pe disaster recovery set karo, alag providers par do regions, latency 30 ms se zyada nahi, SLA 99.99%, budget 300 dollars monthly.

truth.rationale: Colloquial Hinglish query for dual-cloud DR (AWS us-east-1 + Azure eastus) with latency <=30ms, SLA >=99.99%, and budget <=$300/mo.

queries.raw_query_text: Bandwidth autoscale karo 200 se 800 Mbps ke beech, max 10 replicas integer mein, CPU 70 percent se neeche aur mahine ka budget 300 dollars.

truth.rationale: Colloquial Hinglish query for bandwidth autoscaling 200-800 Mbps, <=10 replicas, <=70% CPU, <=$300/mo. Feasible (e.g., 200 Mbps with 4 replicas uses 66.67% CPU and costs $196/mo).

queries.raw_query_text: Set up an AWS deployment with enough memory for my application.

truth.rationale: Vague qualitative request: exact memory requirement (RAM GB), vCPU count, and budget are completely unspecified; requires clarification.

queries.raw_query_text: AWS needs 8 vCPUs and 16 GB RAM; keep the budget below 300.

truth.rationale: Missing budget currency and timeframe units ('below 300' without currency symbol or billing duration); predeclared policy requires clarification for ambiguous budget parameters.

queries.raw_query_text: Give us two small AWS nodes, or perhaps one larger node if that is better, on a reasonable budget.

truth.rationale: Subjective sizing ('small nodes', 'larger node') and unquantified budget ('reasonable budget') lack concrete mathematical bounds and require user clarification.

queries.raw_query_text: Allocate AWS VMs with at least 64 total vCPUs and 256 GB total RAM for at most $20 per month.

truth.rationale: 64 vCPUs and 256 GB RAM cannot be provisioned on AWS under $20/month (cheapest 64-vCPU AWS configuration in catalog costs >$2,000/mo, exceeding budget by >100x).

queries.raw_query_text: For disaster recovery use only AWS, but the two selected regions must belong to different cloud providers. Budget $400, latency 100 ms maximum, SLA 99.99%.

truth.rationale: Mutually contradictory constraints: restricting placement to 'only AWS' directly contradicts the requirement that 'two selected regions must belong to different cloud providers'.

queries.raw_query_text: Autoscale at least 500 Mbps using at most one replica while keeping CPU at or below 50%. Budget $500 monthly.

truth.rationale: Contradictory scaling capacity constraints: 1 replica has 75 Mbps capacity; at 500 Mbps bandwidth, 1 replica requires 666.7% CPU load, which strictly violates the <=50% CPU ceiling (requires at least 14 replicas).

queries.raw_query_text: Choose GPU instances with 24 GB GPU memory for CUDA training within $500 a month.

truth.rationale: GPU instances and CUDA memory allocation are outside the catalog's supported domain (general-purpose CPU VMs, dual-region DR, bandwidth scaling).

queries.raw_query_text: Plan encrypted managed PostgreSQL backups with a seven-year retention policy within $100 per month.

truth.rationale: Database backup retention schedules and encryption storage management are outside the catalog's supported optimization archetypes.

queries.raw_query_text: Allocate four AWS VMs in Mumbai only, each with 4 vCPUs and 16 GB RAM, within $600 monthly; no data may leave India.

truth.rationale: Specific geographical residency / data sovereignty constraint ('Mumbai only / no data may leave India') is unsupported by the benchmark VM catalog (catalog includes US/EU regions without geo-placement tagging for VM SKUs).
